fusions.name: Running Kick
fusions.desc: A flying kick on a target up to 4 tiles away that deals 7 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach, and 5% more for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 25%). Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Bounding Drop
fusions.desc: Bounds up to 6 tiles onto the target and lands with both feet, which deals 15 damage and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Bolt Hole
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 40% for 5 seconds. You finish it 2 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Sprint Into Form
fusions.desc: After you cover enough ground, your next ability deals 25% more damage. Once every 6 seconds.
